items.label: Sumitomo Electric press release: Sumitomo Electric Holds Opening Ceremony for the UK's First (10-19-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Sumitomo Electric opened the UK's first HVDC subsea cable fa

set.signal: Sumitomo Electric opened what it calls the UK's first HVDC subsea cable factory at the Port of Nigg in Scotland on October 19, 2026: a GBP 350 million investment with 58,000 square meters of floor space on a 15-hectare site that will manufacture 525kV XLPE HVDC subsea transmission cables and subsea inter-array cables, creating over 200 skilled local jobs. National Grid says it awarded Sumitomo Electric the contract to supply the HVDC cable for Sea Link, and SSEN Transmission says its proposed Shetland 2 subsea cable project anchored the investment.

items.reason: 'UK's first' is the company's claim (skill §2.4: attribute 'first').
items.evidence: held an opening ceremony on October 19, 2026, for the UK's first HVDC subsea cable factory

items.label: Sunonwealth press release: release News (10-19-2026)
items.signal_prefix: At the OCP Global Summit 2026 in the U.S., Sunonwealth (SUNO

set.signal: At the OCP Global Summit 2026 in the U.S., Sunonwealth (SUNON) officially launched new liquid-cooling products for servers and AI applications - five core products: standard cold plates and DIMM cooling supporting Intel / AMD server platforms; customized liquid-cooling solutions; a 3D-printed cold plate it is exploring with 3D Architech as future research; an In-Rack CDU (L2L / L2A) for lab validation through high-density AI racks; and an In-Row CDU combining its HVAC fan technology. The company says it now has a complete liquid-cooling product line; the products were shown at the summit with static displays and live demonstrations, and the release gives no availability or shipment date.

items.reason: A trade-show unveiling with static displays and live demonstrations, with no availability, production or shipment date and no specs; next_catalyst needs a launch / availability / production start with a date and a demo never fills a slot (skill §2.4, slot table). The entry stays, worded as an unveiling.
